title: Rabbi David Tawil: Shemuel II Chapter 14 - "Abshalom's Return"

chapters.title: Introduction to Shemuel Bet Chapter 14
chapters.about: David's exile of Avshalom and Yoav's plan

chapters.title: The Mashal of the Wise Woman
chapters.about: Yoav orchestrating the woman's plea to the king

chapters.title: Revealing the Nimshal

chapters.title: Parallels to Bereshit
chapters.about: Comparing the story to Cain and Hevel

summary: Rabbi Tawil examines the opening of Shemuel Bet Chapter 14, focusing on Yoav's attempt to persuade David to allow Avshalom to return from exile. Through the use of a mashal presented by a wise woman from Tekoa, the class explores the dynamics of family legacy and the parallels between this situation and the story of Cain and Hevel in Bereshit.
questions: Why did Yoav use a wise woman to speak to David?
How does the story of the woman from Tekoa mirror David's situation with Avshalom?
Why does the woman mention the murder happening in a field?
What is the significance of the legacy of the inheritor in this story?
